srList.sentence: Analysis of the expression level of host genes observed in chimeric reads Gene expression profiles for two SARS-CoV-2 infected Caco-2 cell line samples (GSM4477888, GSM4477889), two SARS-CoV-2 infected Calu-3 cell line samples (GSM4477962, GSM4477963), and three SARS-CoV-2 infected Vero-6 cell line samples (GSM4916368, GSM4916369, GSM4916370) were downloaded from the GEO database.

srList.sentence: METHODS Identification of host-virus chimeric reads in SARS-CoV-2 direct-RNA seq data The nanopore direct RNA-seq data from SARS-CoV-2 infected cell lines were downloaded from the NCBI SRA database (Supplementary Table 1).

sentenceParts.c: METHODS Identification of host-virus chimeric reads in SARS-CoV-2 direct-RNA seq data The nanopore direct RNA-seq data from SARS-CoV-2 infected cell lines were downloaded from the NCBI SRA database (Supplementary Table 1).

srList.sentence: All reads were quality trimmed using NanoFilt v2.8.0 (41), to remove the first 50 nucleotides of each read and require an average quality score of at least 10 over the length of the read.

sentenceParts.c: All reads were quality trimmed using NanoFilt v2.8.0 (41), to remove the first 50 nucleotides of each read and require an average quality score of at least 10 over the length of the read.

srList.sentence: The short reads were first preprocessed with fastp v0.23.1 (44) and then mapped to the chimeric reads from the same samples by using Minimap2 v2.23 (42) with options -ax sr -w 5 to tolerate the high error rate of the Nanopore direct RNA-sequencing reads (45).

srList.sentence: They were searched in the NCBI non-redundant nucleotide database and a collection of coronavirus genomes with BLASTN (E-value<=1e-2) (32) to explore their possible origins.

srList.sentence: The raw sequencing reads were processed for quality control using fastp v0.23.1 (44) with default parameters and mapped to the SARS-CoV-2 reference genome using BWA mem v0.7.17 (52).

srList.sentence: The alignment files were converted to FASTQ format using samtools fastq command v1.14 (54) and re-aligned to the consensus genomes with or without the insertion using bowtie v2.4.4 (45) (parameter: --xeq).
